City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 18, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the November 20, 2019 Special – Closed Session Meeting and November 20, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-12-18 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-12-18 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Resolution 2019-115 Approving the Revised Establishment Document for the Encina Wastewater Authority as Amended. Contact Person: Director of Public Works Quiram
Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution 2019-115 approving the Revised Establishment Document for the Encina Wastewater Authority (EWA) as Amended.
2019-12-18 Item 08C Revised Establishment Document for EWA
8D.
Approval of Position Titles and Pay Ranges for Fiscal Year 2019-20. Contact Person: Human Resources Analyst Burke
Adopt Resolution 2019-109 approving Position Titles and Pay Ranges for the City of Encinitas for Fiscal Year 2019-20.
2019-12-18 Item 08D Position Titles and Pay Ranges for FIscal Year 2019-2020
8E.
GO by BIKE Mini-Grant Council Resolution. Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Karlen
Approve Resolution 2019-105 committing the City of Encinitas to accepting the matching grant funding reimbursement and authorize the City Manager in conjunction with the City Attorney to execute a grant agreement if an award is made by the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG).
2019-12-18 Item 08E GO by BIKE Mini-Grant Council Resolution
8F.
Authorization for the destruction of specific, non-essential, non-permanent records. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Resolution 2019-96 authorizing the destruction of specific, non-essential, non-permanent records in accordance with the City’s Records Retention Schedule and the Government Code.
2019-12-18 Item 08F Destruction of Records
8G.
County of San Diego Contract Number 547764 Agreement, Amendment Numbers 13 and 14 with the City of Encinitas for the Senior Nutrition Program. Contact Person: Senior Center Manager Goodsell
1) Authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment Number 13 of contract number 547764, with the County of San Diego, in substantial form in conjunction with the City Attorney amending the payment schedule and increasing maximum estimated revenue to the City by $4,110 for a total not to exceed $360,706 ; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment Number 14 of contract number 547764, with the County of San Diego, in substantial form in conjunction with the City Attorney extending the term of the agreement one additional month to January 31, 2020, and increasing estimated revenue to the City by $6,351 for a total not to exceed $367,057.
2019-12-18 Item 08G County of San Diego Contract Number 547764 Agreement - Senior Nutrition Program
8H.
Budget Amendment to receive the California Department of Housing and Community Development (HCD) SB 2 Planning Grant and allocate funds to the “Housing Update Implementation” CIP project in the amount of $310,000. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Adopt Resolution 2019-111 “Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget” authorizing a grant fund of $310,000 to the “Housing Update Implementation” CIP project.
2019-12-18 Item 08H SB2 Grant Budget Amendment
8I.
Consideration of Resolution 2019-100 adopting the 2019 Self-Evaluation and Transition Plans, the Grievance Procedure, Administrative Policies G020, G021, G022, G023 and Public Notice under the Americans with Disabilities Act and Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 (ADA/Section 504). Contact Person: Risk Department Manager Schwarm
Adopt by Resolution 2019-100, the Self-Evaluation and Transition plans, the Grievance Procedure, Administrative Policies G020, G021, G022, G023 and Public Notice under the Americans with Disabilities Act and Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 (ADA/Section 504).
2019-12-18 Item 08I ADA Self Evaluation and Transition Plan
8J.
Notice of Completion for the Senior Center ADA Improvements Project (CF18A). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
1) Accept the public improvements as complete; 2) Authorize release of the performance bond and initiate the warranty bond; and 3) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion.
2019-12-18 Item 08J NOC- Senior Center ADA Improvements
8K.
1711 Eolus Storm Drain Improvements Project, (CD05E). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Authorize the City Manager, to execute a contract in substantial form, and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Growth Development Marketing (GDM) Inc. in the amount of $81,180 plus a 15 percent contingency of $12,177 for a total contract amount not to exceed $93,357 to construct the 1711 Eolus Avenue Storm Drain Improvements Project.
2019-12-18 Item 08K 1711 Eolus Storm Drain-Construction Approval
8L.
Opportunistic Beach Fill Program (OBFP) State Lands Commission Lease Agreement. Contact Person: Coastal Zone Program Administrator Timberlake
Adopt Resolution 2019-117 to certify the authorization of the City Manager to sign the State Lands Commission lease agreement as part of the City’s OBFP.
2019-12-18 Item 08L SLC Lease
8M.
Six-month extension of the North Leucadia/Saxony Canyon Peak Hour Fast Response Vehicle Pilot Program; and off-cycle budget appropriation for the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Operating Budget. Contact Person: Fire Chief Stein
1) Authorize the City Manager and Fire Chief to extend the twelve-month pilot program for the peak hour Fast Response Vehicle (FRV) program in the North Leucadia/Saxony Canyon area for an additional six months (through July 2, 2020); and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-106 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget.”
2019-12-18 Item 08M Six-month extension of the Fast Response Vehicle Pilot Program
8N.
Emergency Declaration for water damage remediation and repairs to Encinitas Fire Station #1, 412 Second Street. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Authorize emergency repairs to Fire Station #1 under the Emergency Declaration.
2019-12-18 Item 08N Emergency Declaration FS#1
8O.
Amendment No. 1 to the Contract for Maintenance of Mechanical Systems at City Facilities Between the City of Encinitas and Countywide Mechanical Systems, Inc. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
1) Extends the contract term for an additional one-year term (January 1, 2020 through December 31, 2020); 2) Increases the cost for annual routine maintenance services performed during the renewal term for a total of $67,616 per year, which includes CPI increase; and 3) Includes an estimate of $43,950 for equipment replacement and $15,000 for non-routine emergency services performed during the renewal term.
2019-12-18 Item 08O Countywide Mechanical Services Agreement
8P.
Construction Contract for the Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Improvements Project (CS19B). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
1) Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract in substantial form, and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Tri-Group Construction and Development Inc. in the amount of $1,591,015 plus 15 percent contingency of $238,653, for a total contract amount not to exceed $1,829,668 to construct the Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane ADA Improvements Project; 2) Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute an amendment to the NV5 agreement for as-needed civil engineering services, for an additional amount of $300,000, for a total contract amount not to exceed $750,000; and 3) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-108, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget” to allocate$500,000 to the Morning Sun Drive & Woodside Lane ADA Improvements Project (CS19B).
2019-12-18 Item 08P Morning Sun Drive-Construction Approval
8Q.
Off-cycle budget appropriation for the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Operating Budget for County Service Area 17 (CSA-17) Fund 230. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Jimenez
Adopt Resolution No. 2019-107 approving an off-cycle budget appropriation for the Fiscal Year 2019/20 Operating Budget for the County Service Area 17 (CSA-17) Fund 230.
2019-12-18 Item 08Q CSA-17 Off-Cycle Budget Appropriation Fund 230
8R.
Off-cycle Fiscal Year 2019-20 budget appropriation for Vehicle Replacement Fund 622 and authorization to purchase two (2) all-electric vehicles. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
1) Adopt Resolution Number 2019-103 approving an off-cycle appropriation to the Fiscal Year 2019-20 operating budget for the Fleet Vehicle Replacement Fund 622; and 2) Authorize the purchase of two (2) all-electric vehicles in accordance with the attached quotes, as well as taxes and fees, for an amount not-to-exceed $90,000
2019-12-18 Item 08R Reappropriation Request for Fleet Purchases Packet
8S.
Reject All Bids for the Conservation Demonstration Garden at the Public Works Operations Center (Project). Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Authorize the City Manager to reject all bids and re-bid the project.
2019-12-18 Item 08S City Demo Garden Reject Bids
8T.
Mobility Projects and Grants Update - Capital Improvement Program and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Receive the report on the status of Mobility projects and grants.
2019-12-18 Item 08T Mobility Projects and Grants Update Report
8U.
Authorization to update the City’s phone system. Contact Person: IT Analyst III York
1) Approve upgrading the Cisco Voice Over Internet Protocol (VOIP) phone system as detailed in the Logicalis Statement of Work; 2) Authorize the procurement of Cisco hardware in an amount of $35,606, including a 10 percent contingency of $3,560 for a total of $39,166 using NASPO ValuePoint Master Agreement #AR233 (14-19), Cisco Participating Addendum CA #7-14-70-04 contract; and 3) Authorize the City Manager to enter into a Professional Services Agreement between the City of Encinitas and Logicalis, Inc., in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 in order to upgrade the VOIP phone system in the amount of $28,781, including a 10 percent contingency of $2,878, for a total of $31,659.
2019-12-18 Item 08U Award of Phone System Replacement Contract
8V.
Trench Cut Moratorium Policy. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Adopt a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas to Implement a New Trench Cut Moratorium Policy.
2019-12-18 Item 08V Trench Cut Moratorium Policy
8W.
Amendment to extend the Agreement for Professional Services Between the City of Encinitas and Carpi & Clay, Inc. for Federal Legislative Consulting Services and, the Agreement for Professional Services Between the City of Encinitas and JGC Government Relations, Inc. for State Legislative Consulting Services. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
1) Amendment No. 1 to the Agreement for Professional Services between the City of Encinitas and Carpi & Clay, Inc. for Federal Legislative Consulting Services (Attachment 1), extending the term of the Agreement from December 31, 2019 through March 31, 2020; and 2) Amendment No. 1 to the Agreement for Professional Services between the City of Encinitas and JGC Government Relations, Inc. for Legislative Consulting Services (Attachment 2), extending the term of the Agreement term from December 31, 2019 through March 31, 2020.
2019-12-18 Item 08W Legislative Consulting Services
8X.
Amendment No. 2 to the Contract with Peder Norby to support the Leucadia Streetscape Project. Contact Person: Development Services Director Wisneski
Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute the attached Amendment No. 2 to the Peder Norby Agreement for Project Coordination Consulting Services (“Agreement”), to extend the term through December 31, 2020, and to increase the amount by $60,000, for a total contract amount not-to-exceed $144,000.
2019-12-18 Item 08X Peder Norby Contract Amendment
8Y.
License Agreement with the North County Transit District for the North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Project. Contact Person: Development Services Director Wisneski
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the License Agreement with North County Transit District (NCTD) (in substantial form as provided in Attachment 1) for the construction of the North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Project and ultimate maintenance of the improvements by the City.
2019-12-18 Item 08Y NCTD MOU
8Z.
Award of contract to LeSar Development Consultants for the development of a Homeless Action Plan, in an amount not to exceed $67,285; and authorize the City Manager to enter into a Professional Services Agreement for said services. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a Professional Services Agreement with LeSar Development Consultants, in an amount not to exceed $67,285
2019-12-18 Item 08Z Homeless Action Plan
8AA.
Engineering services contract with NV5 to update the Citywide Sewer Master Plan and Sewer Master Asset Management Plan. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
1) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract in substantial form, and any necessary amendments and time extensions, with NV5 in the amount of $246,194 to update the Citywide Sewer Master Plan and Sewer Master Asset Management Plan and authorize a $20,000 contingency for a total of $266,194; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-116, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Ratifying the Amendment of the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget” to allocate $13,234 to the Encinitas Sanitary Division Sewer Master Plan Update (CE16A) and $13,234 to the Cardiff Sanitary Division Sewer Master Plan Update (CC16B).
2019-12-18 Item 08AA Citywide Sewer Master Plan Update

10A.
Public Hearing to consider a timely-filed appeal of the Planning Commission’s denial of the Vorhees Residential Addition for the renovation of an existing single-family residence with the inclusion of an accessory unit, a façade change, a second-story addition, merger of two underlying legal lots into a single lot, and site improvements. CASE NUMBER: APPEAL-003407-2019 and 17-106 DR/LM/CDP; APPLICANT: Kevin Farrell, AIA, Island Style Architects; APPELLANT: Tom and Amy Vorhees; LOCATION: 2137 Newcastle Avenue (APN 261-061-08) Contact Person: Associate Planner Dichoso

Amendment to Leucadia Streetscape Project (CS04D) Contract with Michael Baker International for design of a regional storm drain system. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
1) Consider the Addendum to (Attachment 1) the Final Environmental Impact Report for the North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Improvement Project; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract amendment with Michael Baker International, in substantial form as contained in Attachment 2. in the amount of $588,000 plus 15 percent contingency for a total contract amendment not to exceed $676,200 for the preparation of plans, specifications and an estimate for a regional storm drain system. Adopt Resolution 2019-99 Committing to Fund the Leucadia Streetscape Project and Authorizing the City Manager to submit a Financing Application and all other required documents to the California Infrastructure and Economic Development Bank (Bank) or Other Financing Institutions. Contact Person: Finance Director McBroome
Adopt Resolution 2019-99 Committing to Fund the Leucadia Streetscape Project and Authorize the City Manager to Submit a Financing Application and all other required documents to the Bank or Other Financing Institutions.
2019-12-18 Item 10C Streetscape Financing
2019-12-18 Item 10C Streetscape Financing - City Presentation
10D.
Public Hearing and Introduction of Ordinance 2019-30, an Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.27 – Expanded Polystyrene Disposable Food Service Ware Prohibition Ordinance. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
1) Receive the informational report on the comprehensive City of Encinitas Plastics Initiative and Phasing Plan, and provide new and/or additional direction to staff; 2) Open the Public Hearing; and 3) Introduce Ordinance 2019-30, titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas amending Chapter 11.27 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Prohibiting the Use and Distribution of Expanded Polystyrene Disposable Food Service Ware, Plastic Utensils, and Beverage Straws.”

Standard Pacific Park Site Naming. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
Staff Recommends that City Council review the recommended names from the Parks and Recreation Commission and provide direction on a name for the Standard Pacific Park Site.
2019-12-18 Item 10E Standard Pacific Park Site Naming

INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Informational report on the status of the Leucadia North Highway 101 Streetscape Project and related projects including the El Portal Undercrossing. Contact Person: Director of Development Services Wisneski
Receive the oral report and provide direction as necessary.

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JANUARY 22, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
